title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the joint communication on humanitarian aid (JOIN(2026)0025)
part_text: 11. Calls for the EU to support humanitarian action that is firmly guided by the principles of humanity, impartiality, neutrality and independence; is concerned about attacks on humanitarian workers, medical personnel and humanitarian infrastructure, and by all forms of violence against civilians, including conflict-related sexual violence, in humanitarian contexts[[2]](#footnote-2)1; calls on the Commission, the EEAS, EU delegations and the Member States to ensure that EU humanitarian funding is used exclusively for life-saving assistance, protection, food security, healthcare, shelter and basic education, thereby providing rapid relief to all persons affected by crises without discrimination, and not for the promotion of political, ideological or social agendas unrelated to immediate humanitarian needs; stresses that all EU-funded activities should be subject to regular assessments that demonstrate their direct humanitarian impact;
